description:
Matches ingredient names to FoodData Central foods and converts portions to grams.

Portions such as 2 tbsp, 1/2 cup, or 1 medium are converted with each
food's own measured portions, so 1 cup differs for spinach and olive oil.
Repeated ingredients are looked up once. method says how each portion was
converted. Ingredients that could not be converted are listed under
unresolved with the portions that food supports, and alternatives lists
runner-up matches with their fdc_id. Bare names such as rice or beans
match many records; names with the cooked state, such as cooked white rice,
match more precisely. About a fifth of USDA foods have a portion table.

items.description: Ingredients, each with a food name or fdc_id and a portion or grams, e.g. {"food": "eggplant", "portion": "2 medium"}.

fdc_id.description: FoodData Central id, which pins an exact food.

grams.description: Weight in grams, in place of a portion.

portion.description: Portion such as 2 tbsp, 1/2 cup, 1 medium, or 150 g.
